form_analysis.feedback: Standard facial aftercare form with clear, practical advice. Effectively covers the essential post-treatment reactions, product use, and environmental triggers. Good emphasis on hydration and sun protection. Lacks a specific emergency protocol, which is typical and appropriate for this low-risk treatment.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is essential to help soothe your skin, prolong the benefits of your treatment, and prevent any irritation or breakouts.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow this aftercare advice to care for your skin following your deep cleansing facial.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: Your skin may appear pink/red, feel warm, tight, or slightly sensitive immediately after your facial. This is a normal reaction and should settle within a few hours to 24 hours. You may notice some mild dryness or flaking over the next 1-2 days as your skin sheds impurities.

sections.title: Cleansing and Product Use
items: Do not wash your face for at least 4-6 hours after treatment to allow the products to fully absorb and work.
After this period, cleanse gently with a mild, non-abrasive cleanser recommended by your therapist.
Avoid using any exfoliating scrubs, brushes (like Clarisonic), or acid-based products (AHA/BHA, retinol) for the next 3-5 days.
You may resume your regular skincare routine, excluding exfoliants, after 3 days or as advised by your therapist.

sections.title: Hydration and Soothing
sections.content: Apply a gentle, hydrating moisturizer liberally. If your skin feels particularly warm, a cool compress can be soothing. Drink plenty of water to help flush out toxins and keep your skin hydrated from within.

sections.title: Activity, Environmental and Sun Protection
items: Avoid sun exposure, sunbeds, and excessive heat (saunas, steam rooms, very hot showers) for at least 48 hours as your skin will be more sensitive.
If you must go outside, apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher. This is non-negotiable.
Avoid swimming in chlorinated pools or the sea for 24-48 hours.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: It is best to avoid wearing makeup for 24 hours to allow your pores to breathe. If you must apply makeup, ensure it is non-comedogenic and apply it gently with clean tools.

sections.title: Dietary Considerations
sections.content: Avoid alcohol and excessively spicy foods for 24 hours as they can cause flushing and counteract the calming effects of the facial.

sections.title: Breakout Response (Purging)
sections.content: A deep cleansing facial can accelerate your skin's natural renewal process. It is not uncommon to experience a few small breakouts or whiteheads 1-3 days after treatment as impurities are brought to the surface. This is temporary. Do not pick or squeeze these spots; keep the area clean and allow them to heal naturally.

sections.title: Infection Awareness
sections.content: While very rare with professional treatments, you must contact your therapist if you experience any signs of infection such as increasing pain, spreading redness, heat, or pus.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: Contact your therapist if you experience any severe or persistent irritation, rash, or unexpected reaction.
The full clarifying and brightening results of your facial will be visible within 2-3 days as your skin settles.
For best results, maintain a consistent home care routine and schedule regular treatments as recommended by your therapist.
